newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel Corp completes rebranding move.
newsitem.headline: Keppel Corp completes rebranding move.

text.p: Singapore conglomerate Keppel Corp said on Friday it had completed renaming and rebranding its publicly listed units to boost corporate identity to assist the group's push into new overseas markets.

"This is part of an exercise by the group to optimise on the Keppel name so as to enhance the market position of its various units, especially in their move into new markets overseas," a group statement said.
The plans to rename and rebrand the units using a new wordmark logo were announced in December 1996.

Straits Steamship Land Ltd, Far East Levingston Shipbuilding Ltd, Steamers Maritime Holdings Ltd and Singmarine Industries Ltd become respectively Keppel Land Ltd, Keppel FELS Ltd, Keppel Telecommunications & Transport Ltd and Keppel Marine Industries Ltd.
The rebranded units are Keppel Bank Ltd, Keppel Finance Ltd, Keppel Integrated Engineering Ltd, Keppel Philippines Ltd, Keppel Batangas Dockyard Inc and Keppel Cebu Shipyard and Engineering Inc.
